display_description: Design a 1.8 V cascoded current-mirror OTA configured as a unity-gain buffer across TT, FF, and SS process corners.
Design a dual-supply two-stage CMOS op amp with common-mode, gain, bandwidth, overload-swing, and distortion requirements.
Design an NMOS differential stage with a PMOS current-mirror load, an NMOS source-follower output, and an open 0.08 feedback network.
Design a transistor-level AGC controller with filtered differential detection, two physical feedback stages, command-range, polarity, and settling requirements.

Design a complete 3.3 V transistor-level differential TIA with dual variable-gain stages, an output buffer, a Gilbert peak detector, automatic gain control, overload cancellation, and PAM4 verification.
